# `<ptfkit/williams1992.h>`

```c
#include <ptfkit/williams1992.h>
```

Williams et al. (1992) Campbell water-retention regressions and parameter table.

## Source

Williams, J., Ross, P. J., & Bristow, K. L. (1992). Prediction of the Campbell water retention function from texture, structure, and organic matter. In M. Th. van Genuchten, F. J. Leij, & L. J. Lund (Eds.), Proceedings of the International Workshop on Indirect Methods for Estimating the Hydraulic Properties of Unsaturated Soils (pp. 427-441). University of California, Riverside.

## Scope

**Territory:** Australia, England and Wales, and the United States

**Dataset:** Regressions were developed from the Prebble and Forrest Australian data sets, their combination, or the Hall England-and-Wales data set, and were evaluated where compatible against independent Australian, UK, and US data.

[PTF catalog page](../../../ptf-catalog/sources/williams1992.md)

## `williams1992_soil_structure`

Source-defined two-level indicator for absence or presence of pedality.

```c
typedef enum {
    williams1992_soil_structure_massive,
    williams1992_soil_structure_structured,
} williams1992_soil_structure;
```

| Member | Canonical value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `williams1992_soil_structure_massive` | `1` | Massive soil, assigned STR = 1. |
| `williams1992_soil_structure_structured` | `2` | Structured soil, assigned STR = 2. |

## `williams1992_table5_parameters`

```c

 } williams1992_table5_parameters;
```

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |

| `air_entry_head` | Campbell nominal air-entry pressure-head magnitude predicted with Function 7. (cm) |

## Functions

### `calc_ptf_williams1992_function_1` {#function-calc_ptf_williams1992_function_1}

Predict volumetric water content with Williams et al. Function 1.

```c
static inline double calc_ptf_williams1992_function_1(double clay, double fine_sand, double coarse_sand, double organic_matter, double water_potential);
```

#### Parameters

| Name | Direction | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `clay` | in | Clay below 0.002 mm, as a mass percentage. (%) |
| `fine_sand` | in | Fine sand from 0.02 to 0.20 mm, as a mass percentage. (%) |
| `coarse_sand` | in | Coarse sand from 0.20 to 2.0 mm, as a mass percentage. (%) |
| `organic_matter` | in | Organic-matter mass percentage. (%) |
| `water_potential` | in | Water-potential magnitude. (bar) |

#### Returns

Predicted volumetric water content at the supplied water-potential magnitude. (%)

!!! note

    Natural logarithms are used.

!!! warning

    The source does not publish exact multivariate calibration boundaries.

### `calc_ptf_williams1992_function_6` {#function-calc_ptf_williams1992_function_6}

Predict volumetric water content with Williams et al. Function 6.

```c
static inline double calc_ptf_williams1992_function_6(double clay, double fine_sand, williams1992_texture_class texture_class, double organic_matter, double silt, double water_potential);
```

#### Parameters

| Name | Direction | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `clay` | in | Clay below 0.002 mm, as a mass percentage. (%) |
| `fine_sand` | in | Fine sand from 0.02 to 0.20 mm, as a mass percentage. (%) |
| `texture_class` | in | Northcote field-texture group supplying TEX in the Function 6 regression. |
| `organic_matter` | in | Organic-matter mass percentage. (%) |
| `silt` | in | Silt from 0.002 to 0.02 mm, as a mass percentage. (%) |
| `water_potential` | in | Water-potential magnitude. (bar) |

#### Returns

Predicted volumetric water content at the supplied water-potential magnitude. (%)

!!! note

    The printed ln(C^2) term is evaluated literally as the natural logarithm of clay squared.

!!! warning

    The source reports collapse for high-clay British Fen soils with organic matter exceeding 30 percent.

!!! warning

    The source does not publish exact multivariate calibration boundaries.

### `calc_ptf_williams1992_table5` {#function-calc_ptf_williams1992_table5}

Return the published Function 7 Campbell parameters for a Table 5 soil group.

```c
static inline williams1992_table5_parameters calc_ptf_williams1992_table5(williams1992_table_5_soil_group soil_group);
```

#### Parameters

| Name | Direction | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `soil_group` | in | Published structure and field-texture combination used to select a Table 5 row. |

#### Returns

A `williams1992_table5_parameters` value.

!!! note

    All rows use the source-fixed bulk density of 1.4 g/cm^3.

!!! warning

    The tabulated values are rounded predictions from Function 7.
